title: Lightning bolt with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Glow aura -->
  <polygon points="56,8 28,54 46,54 38,92 72,42 52,42 62,8" fill="#FFD700" opacity="0.25"/>

  <!-- Lightning bolt body -->
  <polygon points="56,10 30,52 46,52 38,90 70,44 52,44 64,10" fill="#FFE033"/>

  <!-- Lighter edge highlight to give depth without dark outline -->
  <polygon points="56,10 30,52 46,52 38,90 70,44 52,44 64,10"
           fill="none" stroke="#FFF59D" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- Inner shine along left side -->
  <polygon points="54,16 36,48 46,48 42,76 56,42 48,42 58,16" fill="#FFF176" opacity="0.55"/>

  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="47" cy="42" rx="4.2" ry="5.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <ellipse cx="59" cy="42" rx="4.2" ry="5.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Pupils -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="43" rx="2" ry="2.8" fill="#5C3D00"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="43" rx="2" ry="2.8" fill="#5C3D00"/>

  <!-- Eye sparkles -->
  <circle cx="46.5" cy="40.5" r="1.1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="58.5" cy="40.5" r="1.1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M46,50 Q53,57 60,50" fill="none" stroke="#8B5A00" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="49" rx="3.2" ry="2.2" fill="#FFAB91" opacity="0.85"/>
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="49" rx="3.2" ry="2.2" fill="#FFAB91" opacity="0.85"/>

  <!-- Tiny sparkle accents -->
  <path d="M74,24 L77,28 L74,32 L71,28 Z" fill="#FFF9C4"/>
  <path d="M28,68 L30,71 L28,74 L26,71 Z" fill="#FFF9C4"/>
</svg>
